alignments.note: Connective conjunction.
Ordinary conditional particle (rule 72).

`ψωμίζω` is to dole out food, and the ASV spreads it over *bestow … to feed the poor*; the supplied recipient completes what this one verb was going to say and no other token licenses it, so it is folded here under rules 7 and 74 rather than marked `added`. Head on *bestow*, the finite verb word. Marking *the poor* `added` under rules 5 and 103 remains defensible.
Quantifier.
The genitive pronoun `μου` is free and takes the English possessive, displacing the article's determiner (rule 20).
Genitive pronoun realized by the possessive *my* (rule 20).
Substantival participle rendered by the noun *goods*.
Coordinating conjunction.
Ordinary conditional particle (rule 72).
Subjunctive with its supplied subject; head on the verb (rules 9, 17).
`μου` takes the possessive *my*, so the article's determiner slot is occupied (rule 20).
Genitive pronoun realized by *my*.
Head noun.
Purpose conjunction realized by the word introducing its English clause, here the infinitival *to* (rule 40).

Passive verb with its copular auxiliary; head on the lexical verb (rules 9, 17). The projection carries `καυθήσομαι`, which the ASV's *be burned* translates; the variant *that I may glory* is the ASV's own textual note and no new decision is made here (rule 12).
Adversative conjunction.
Finite verb.
Ordinary negative aligned to *not*; `οὐδέν` stands in the following clause, so no redundant-negative rule applies.
Object noun.
Passive verb recast with a supplied expletive subject and an English object pronoun; head on the lexical verb (rule 17).
Negative indefinite carrying the clause's negation.

review_notes: The supplied *the poor* is folded into `ψωμίσω` because that lexeme's own English (*to feed* someone) is still incomplete and no other token licenses the words; the `added` reading under rule 103 is noted in the unit.
Both articles governing `σῶμα` and `ὑπάρχοντα` are `unrepresented`, the free genitive `μου` occupying the determiner slot each time (rule 20).
